bondPriority.description: Increases Technique DMG by 32% during battle. When Ailment DMG Bonus is equal or higher than 80%, Ailment DMG Bonus is increased by extra 80%.
bondPriority.name: Gin Bond

bondPriority.description: During battle, DMG dealt increases by 8%. This increases to 12% / 16% / 20%, if Crit Rate reaches 20% / 40% / 60%.
bondPriority.name: Toshiro Bond

boundaries.description: Gains 3 Technique Points immediately when entering battle. Fully restores Technique Points after releasing the Ultimate.
boundaries.name: Devouring Mouth

boundaries.description: For every 1 Technique Point consumed, the Crit DMG of the next Ultimate is increased by 35%, stacking up to 6 times. Hitting the enemy with the final strike of the Basic Attack reduces Technique Points recovery time by 2 seconds.
boundaries.name: Manhunt

boundaries.description: The Ultimate inflicts Snake Venom on the enemy, dealing DMG equal to 50% of ATK every second. Snake Venom explodes after 12 seconds, dealing further DMG equal to 40% of the total DMG dealt by Gin during this 12-second period, up to 2,500 of Gin's current ATK. While charging a technique, an additional wide-area Thrust attack is released without interrupting the charge (up to 600% of ATK based on charge time).
boundaries.name: Cell Dissolution

corePassives.description:
Gin's attacks inflict Impale Scale on the enemy. Upon reaching 100, triggers Impale once, dealing damage equal to 500% of Gin's ATK to the target. 
 Except for Gin's attacks, his teammates' special attacks, techniques, Battlefield Skills, Ultimates, and counterattacks also inflict 35 Impale Scale on the enemy. Cooldown: 1 second. Impale triggered by teammates' attacks is counted as if triggered by Gin's attacks.
corePassives.name: Hundred Blades

corePassives.description: Increases the Spiritual Pressure Charge Rate by 100% when landing a basic attack.
corePassives.name: Disguise

corePassives.description: Each time Impale damage is triggered, Technique Points recovery time is reduced by 5 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds.
corePassives.name: Lurking

corePassives.description: Increases Technique DMG by an extra 60% when attacking enemies affected by debuffs.
corePassives.name: Into the Abyss

rotations.name: Shinso Shinso Shinso
rotations.notes: Gin's Weapon Ascension 3 is crucial to the unit's overall damage. Prioritize upgrading the weapon over boundaries after B2.
steps: Gin Technique (1x) → Manual Counter → Technique (2x) → Technique (1x)
Ultimate to trigger Impale whenever it's available

skills.description:
Gin swiftly strikes the enemy in front of him 5 times with Shinso, dealing damage equal to 820% of ATK and inflicting 40 Impale Scale. 
 Gin also accumulates Spiritual Pressure if his attack hits the enemy. ~~Serpent Tail Penetration~~ Tap basic attack after triggering a Perfect Dodge, releasing Spear Rain or Blade-Sundering Spear 
 Gin rapidly impales the enemy with Shinso, dealing DMG equal to 675% of ATK and inflicting 30 Impale Scale. 
 Upon a successful hit, Gin's Spiritual Pressure is increased. ~~Lightning Thrust~~  ~~Spear Thrust~~ Press and hold basic attack with 50 or more Spiritual Pressure 
 Gin thrusts forward with Shinso, dealing damage equal to 550% of ATK and inflicting 15 Impale Scale. 
 Upon a successful hit, the recovery time of Technique Points is reduced by 1 second(s). ~~Spear Rain~~ Quickly tap or tap and hold the basic attack when Spiritual Pressure is no less than 50 after performing a Spear Thrust 
 Gin leaps over the enemy and extends Shinso to attack mid-air, dealing damage equal to 825% of ATK and inflicting 25 Impale Scale. 
 Upon a successful hit, the recovery time of Technique Points is reduced by 2 second(s).
skills.name: Impale Him, Shinso

skills.description:
Gin enters the charging state, consuming 1 Technique Point per charge to boost the Technique power. Releasing the Skill button or upon depleting all Technique Points triggers an attack corresponding to the total points consumed during the charge state. 
 Gin is invincible during charging. 
 Recovers 1 Technique Point automatically every 10 seconds. ~~Thrusting Spear~~ Consumes 1 Technique Point 
 Gin instantly extends Shinso to attack the enemy, dealing damage equal to 575% of ATK and inflicting 12 Impale Scale. ~~Serpent Shadow Spear~~ Consumes 2 Technique Points 
 Gin extends Shinso to attack all enemies within a fan-shaped area, dealing damage equal to 1150% of ATK and inflicting 24 Impale Scale. ~~Blade-Sundering Spear~~ Consumes 3 Technique Points 
 Gin quickly slashes the enemy multiple times, then dashes behind the enemy and launches them into the air, dealing damage equal to 2300% of ATK and inflicting 36 Impale Scale.
skills.name: Shinso Unsheathed

skills.description: Gin fast approaches the enemy and performs multiple slashes. He then releases his Bankai and launches a fatal strike much faster than the speed under the Shikai state, dealing damage equal to 4050% of ATK and inflicting 60 Impale Scale.
skills.name: Bankai - Kamishini no Yari

skills.description:
Gin seizes the enemy's opening and counterattacks with Shinso, dealing damage equal to 1600% of ATK and inflicting 50 Impale Scale. 
 Gin gains 1 Technique Point(s) if he counters successfully.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description:
Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Gin Ichimaru gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds. 
 Gin gains 1 Technique Point on triggering Perfect Dodge.
skills.name: Flash Step
